scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kinetra/shared && npm run build -w @kinetra/backend && npm run build -w @kinetra/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kinetra/shared && npm run typecheck -w @kinetra/backend && npm run typecheck -w @kinetra/frontend
scripts.test:frontend:browser: npm run build -w @kinetra/shared && npm run build -w @kinetra/frontend && node scripts/test-frontend-browser.mjs
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test:frontend:unit && npm run test:frontend:browser
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run verify:structure && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
